Tip E049 reads 5.198 s and 0.7535 on seeds 0–2. Rebuilds of the same commit read 5.198, 5.206 and 5.223 s, so time noise is about ±0.03–0.05 s. The 3-seed accuracy mean moves about ±0.2–0.3 pp across rebuilds. E049's three builds read 0.7535, 0.7552 and 0.7536. E036's builds read 0.7532, 0.7525, 0.7497 and 0.7544.

Mechanisms:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 1–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near that dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, because a frozen block also skips BN/GELU backward, the optimizer update and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049). Group 2 shows no cliff at 85% (E053).
4. Group 1 needs steady training and 32 px exposure. Losing it is a graded dose (E037 −0.45 pp, E054 −0.35, E055 about −0.15).
5. Averaging, LS, warm-up, Lookahead interval and BN recalibration are null or negative. wd ×0.5 gave about +0.2 pp (E016). The recipe is near a local optimum.
6. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses more than it saves. Elementwise bytes are a real lever (E056 ReLU, about −0.25 s).
7. Build noise and seed-set winner's curse (0.1–0.2 pp) dominate every decision under 0.15 pp. The population mean is about 0.752–0.754.
8. My time forecasts for trim runs have been too high by 0.1–0.2 s. E052 and E053 ran faster than the commit-time forecasts. Same-commit rebuilds land near their old times.

Unsure: the true rebuild SD, whether coarse labels are shipped and allowed, PCIe transfer, and whether the 3-seed gate can pass a faster recipe.

Tip E049 reads 5.198 s and 0.7535 on seeds 0–2. Rebuilds of the same commit read 5.198, 5.206 and 5.223 s, so time noise is about ±0.03–0.05 s. The 3-seed accuracy mean moves about ±0.2–0.3 pp across rebuilds. E049's three builds read 0.7535, 0.7552 and 0.7536. E036's builds read 0.7532, 0.7525, 0.7497 and 0.7544.

Mechanisms:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 1–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near that dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, because a frozen block also skips BN/GELU backward, the optimizer update and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049). Group 2 shows no cliff at 85% (E053).
4. Group 1 needs steady training and 32 px exposure. Losing it is a graded dose (E037 −0.45 pp, E054 −0.35, E055 about −0.15).
5. Averaging, LS, warm-up, Lookahead interval and BN recalibration are null or negative. wd ×0.5 gave about +0.2 pp (E016). The recipe is near a local optimum.
6. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses more than it saves. Elementwise bytes are a real lever (E056 ReLU, about −0.25 s).
7. Build noise and seed-set winner's curse (0.1–0.2 pp) dominate every decision under 0.15 pp. The population mean is about 0.752–0.754.

forecasts.reason: E046 is 0.25 epoch shorter than E049, so time ≈ 5.08–5.10 s. The accuracy gap to E049 (~0.1 pp) is within build noise, so the dial price stays unresolved.
Likely blocked or not run. The 100×100 soft-target matrix adds almost no time. If it does run, the accuracy effect is probably small and uncertain.
The port already freezes BN weight (requires_grad=False in BatchNorm.__init__), so the idea closes by code read. If it did run, the result would equal the tip.
The saving is about 0.01–0.03 s, below build noise. The accuracy change is likely within ±0.1 pp, so the result cannot be separated from noise.
Offline diagnostic with no recipe change. The curves will probably order the known outcomes loosely, with whitening bias early and group 1 late.

cruxes: Does the 3-seed gate (≥0.753) pass a faster recipe such as E046 or E052 on a given build, or is the population mean about 0.752 so that passing is mostly luck?
Does the shipped CIFAR-100 train set include coarse labels, and do RULES.md allow using them?
What is the true rebuild SD of the 20-seed mean (about 0.05 vs 0.15 pp)? It decides whether any sub-0.15 pp comparison means anything.
